usecase.name: Flight Search
usecase.scenario: A user searches for flights between two destinations on specific dates.
usecase.preconditions: User is on the flight search page.
steps: User selects departure and destination locations.

testcases.name: Valid Flight Search
testcases.description: Verify that a user can successfully search for flights with valid destinations and dates.

testcases.name: Flight Search with Invalid Dates
testcases.description: Verify that the system handles searches with past or invalid dates.

usecase.name: Tour or Activity Booking
usecase.scenario: A user books a tour or activity after reviewing the details and confirming payment.
usecase.preconditions: User is logged in and has selected a tour or activity.
steps: User reviews tour or activity details.
User selects the date and number of participants.

testcases.name: Valid Tour Booking
testcases.description: Verify that a user can successfully book a tour with valid details and payment.

testcases.name: Booking with Invalid Payment
testcases.description: Verify that the system handles invalid payment details during tour booking.

testcases.name: Overbooking Participants
testcases.description: Verify that the system handles the case where the number of participants exceeds the tour capacity.
